text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking past the station,
I see a
pair of familiar faces calling out
to passersby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Um, h-hello! We're having an, uh, event,
at, um,
Tracen Academy, so, um...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
The student council is having an event!
Do feel
free to take a flyer!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, I'm really bad at this. I'm not
helping
at all, am I?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. You're doing just
fine. I'm
sure you'll get the hang of it
once—
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
...Sorry. I've just received a text from the

president.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: "Return to the academy ASAP." Oh?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to at least hand out half of
these,
but oh well. Back to school it is.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
...Please go on ahead. I'll stay here and
keep
handing out flyers.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? You might have to deal
with
gawkers or talk to people you
aren't comfortable
with...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I know... But I really want to help you
out for
once.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
...All right. Just don't push yourself too
hard,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Breathe in... Breathe out... Okay. I can
do this. I
just need to announce that
we're holding an
event...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
An event? Академия Тайсен is doing
something?
Yeah, I think I might grab a
flyer.
text_block_list.name: Male Passerby

text_block_list.text: Oh?! G-go ahead.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Th-that was just a practice run. Next
time, I'm
going to speak clearly and
hand out the flyers
myself!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Is she from Академия Тайсен? Oh,
she's
looking this way! Hellooo!
text_block_list.name: Tourist Group

text_block_list.text:
Ignore... the stares. Ignore... the...
s-stares...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I... I can't do it! What should I do? I went
and told
Эйр Грув I could handle this.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
And after I made up my mind that I
wouldn't let
any obstacle get in my
way...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I'll scale any walls that stand in my way!
This is
what you meant when you were
talking about
working toward becoming
your ideal self, right,
Kawakami?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: I was so sure, but in the end, I... I...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Добер is trembling in distress. I
wonder if
there's anything I can say to
assuage her fears?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Добер is trembling in distress. I
wonder if
there's anything I can say to
assuage her fears?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ah, here yo—wait, you're...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Flyers? Is there some kind of event
going on?
Whoa! Академия Тайсен's
putting on an event?!
text_block_list.name: Passersby

text_block_list.text:
Oh, they're having a raffle for
autographs too!
Oh my gosh, yeah! Can I
get a flyer, please?!
Me too, me too!
text_block_list.name: Passersby

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Perhaps I called out to her a little too loudly. So many people are rushing over, there's no way she can possibly handle them alone!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I-I'll help you hand those out!

text_block_list.text:
I don't believe it. I handed out all the
flyers?
Seriously?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Uh... I wasn't asking you.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
...Thanks. I couldn't have handed them
all out
without you.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
All of them, you say? You mean you
finished
handing them out?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Incredible. You surpassed all my
expectations. I
guess my worries were
unfounded.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Dober, you've really changed. I'm
pleased to see
how much you've grown.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you so much!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
But I didn't accomplish this alone. I had
help. So
really...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Heh, forget about all that for now. You'll
figure it
out one day.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
But your efforts really have helped. So,
I'll say
this...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: That was directed at you too, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Um, I also wanted to say... You helped,
uh, a bit...
Bye.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Um! I also wanted to say... Thank you so,
so much!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Eek! The wind's too strong! Oh no! The
flyers are
getting blown away!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a strong gust of wind scatters
all the
flyers! In a panic, I rush to help
gather them up...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... I think we somehow managed to get all of them, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I'm finally ba—oh, what happened
here?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I see. That sounds like quite the disaster.

...Dober.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: ...A-Эйр Грув, I'm so sor—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Well done. You did the best you could.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You used to be too timid to even put
yourself out
there. I'm pleased to see
how much you've grown.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
But I... I said I'd take care of it for you,
and I
couldn't even hand out a single
flyer.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Heh, forget about all that for now. You'll
figure it
out one day.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Thanks for your help too, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, that badge on your collar...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
...No thanks. And don't give me your
trainer spiel,
either.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Thanks, but I don't want to bother one
of the
academy's trainers. I appreciate
the sentiment,
though.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Hmph! You're so nosy! I can do this by myself! I have to do this by myself!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
No, really, I'm okay. I should do this by
myself!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
What's this? What's all the commotion
about?
Looks like they're passing out
flyers? What for?
text_block_list.name: Student Passersby

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh! Um!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Hey! ...Oh, fine!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Oh... you're just too nice. You'll be stuck
here all
day at this rate.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Without giving her much of a chance to
refuse my
help, I start handing out the
flyers...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew... We still have half of the flyers left, but it's already getting dark. If we just keep going for a little longer...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
No need. Well done, you've handed out
more
than enough.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Wow, you really handed out half of
them. You
went all out.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: ...You've really grown, Dober.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Oh, n-not at all. I was just kicking up a

commotion.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
In the end, I still needed help getting
people's
attention and handing out
flyers. So really...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Heh, forget about all that for now. You'll
figure it
out one day.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
But your efforts really have helped me
out. So,
thank you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: That was directed at you too, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
...I didn't ask you to help, but... thanks. I
guess.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's the pride she feels at having

distributed all the flyers, but when I
catch a brief
glimpse of Мэдзиро Добер's
profile, I see a smile on
her face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Добер returns to the academy
deep in
thought, pondering the meaning
behind Air
Groove's words.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm sorry for all the trouble! Thank
you very
much!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
